title: The 150% volume warning has a glitched animation if the animation are deactivated
line: With animations turned off, the Audio Volume popup's "Raise maximum volume" warning now appears in one clean step instead of flashing over the switch first.
explanation: Kirigami's InlineMessage animates its height and opacity when shown, gated only on visibility. With animations off Plasma sets longDuration to 1 ms rather than 0, so the height animation still ran and only finished on the next animation tick: for one or two frames the message was laid out at zero height and its text drew over the switch below it. The two Behaviors are now skipped when longDuration is 1 ms or less, the convention Plasma uses elsewhere for 'animations off', so the message gets its full height in the same frame.

commits.message:
InlineMessage: don't animate showing and hiding when animations are off

With animations disabled the height and opacity behaviors still ran a
1 ms animation, so a newly shown message was laid out at zero height for
a frame and drawn over the items below it. Skip them in that case.

BUG: 521166

patches.diff:
From e277f3deb7e4b5d8f12a0f6fd5fe945aec7c7e84 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 05:20:09 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] InlineMessage: don't animate showing and hiding when
 animations are off

With animations disabled the height and opacity behaviors still ran a
1 ms animation, so a newly shown message was laid out at zero height for
a frame and drawn over the items below it. Skip them in that case.

BUG: 521166
---
 src/templates/InlineMessage.qml | 4 ++--
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/src/templates/InlineMessage.qml b/src/templates/InlineMessage.qml
index 85d3b300..a463b3af 100644
--- a/src/templates/InlineMessage.qml
+++ b/src/templates/InlineMessage.qml
@@ -223,7 +223,7 @@ T.Control {
     Accessible.ignored: !visible
 
     Behavior on implicitHeight {
-        enabled: !root.visible
+        enabled: !root.visible && Platform.Units.longDuration > 1
 
         SequentialAnimation {
             PropertyAction { targets: root; property: "_animating"; value: true }
@@ -240,7 +240,7 @@ T.Control {
     opacity: visible ? 1 : 0
 
     Behavior on opacity {
-        enabled: !root.visible
+        enabled: !root.visible && Platform.Units.longDuration > 1
 
         NumberAnimation { duration: Platform.Units.shortDuration }
     }
--

review.text: Right layer (Kirigami InlineMessage) and good diagnosis of Plasma clamping longDuration to 1 ms when animations are disabled, eliminating the zero-height overlap frame on root. However, InlineMessage's third show-transition Behavior (contentLayout's Behavior on opacity at line 267, running for shortDuration * 2) is left unguarded and only avoids animating by relying on QML binding evaluation order between root.opacity and contentLayout's Behavior.enabled. The commit title also inaccurately mentions hiding, which InlineMessage does not animate.
changes: Also guard contentLayout's Behavior on opacity (src/templates/InlineMessage.qml:268) with Platform.Units.longDuration > 1 (or shortDuration > 1) so showing with animations disabled cannot trigger a 2 ms content fade-in if binding evaluation order changes.
Update the commit subject to say 'showing' rather than 'showing and hiding', since hiding is already un-animated.

reviews.text: Right layer: the glitch is in Kirigami's InlineMessage show transition, whose height/opacity Behaviors still ran a 1 ms animation because libplasma's kirigamiplasmastyle clamps longDuration to at least 1, so the message was laid out at zero height for a frame and drawn over the switch. Gating both Behaviors on longDuration > 1 follows the existing Plasma convention (BusyIndicator, Splash, NotificationPopup) and also covers non-Plasma platforms where durations drop to 0; _animating stays consistent since it is only set inside the skipped Behavior. The before/after frame strips clearly show the overlap gone on every toggle, and the default-speed animation is unchanged; small, honest diff with BUG: 521166.
